Title: contact us form with file upload
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Test Data: Name "QA Tester", e-mail qa.tester@example.com, text file attachment.
Steps:
1. Open /contact_us and verify "Get In Touch" is visible.
2. Enter name, e-mail, subject and message.
3. Upload a file.
4. Click "Submit" and accept the confirmation dialog.
5. Verify the success message and click "Home".
Expected Result: "Success! Your details have been submitted successfully." is shown; Home opens the home page.

Title: contact form blocks an invalid e-mail
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /contact_us.
2. Fill all fields with the e-mail "broken-email" and click "Submit".
Expected Result: Browser validation blocks the submit; no success message appears.

Title: contact form blocks a submit without an e-mail
Preconditions: Browser open, user not logged in, empty cart.
Steps:
1. Open /contact_us.
2. Click "Submit" with all fields empty.
Expected Result: The mandatory e-mail field blocks the submit; no success message appears.
